name: MCHPRS

Uses the prebuilt container image; change the image in the Docker Images section if you host your own fork (ghcr.io/<owner>/<repo>).

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Nothing to install: the server binary ships inside the container image.
mkdir -p /mnt/server
echo "MCHPRS is provided by the container image; nothing to install."

variables.name: Log filter
variables.description: Logging filter (MCHPRS_LOG), e.g. info, debug or mchprs_core=debug,info.

variables.name: MOTD
variables.description: Message of the day shown in the server list (Config.toml: motd).

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: Maximum number of simultaneous players (Config.toml: max_players).

variables.name: View distance
variables.description: Maximal distance in chunks between players and loaded chunks (Config.toml: view_distance).

variables.name: Velocity forwarding
variables.description: Set to true to enable Velocity modern forwarding. Requires a Velocity secret. Leave false for direct connections.

variables.name: Velocity secret
variables.description: The forwarding secret itself (the contents of forwarding-secret-file on the proxy, NOT a path). Only used when Velocity forwarding is true.
